stem: Which reason does the passage give for this situation: “But some travelers were still sent to human officers”?
options: They are needed for function, but because they create common experience
The system could not read their faces correctly or their documents needed checking

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They are needed for function, but because they create common experience」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The wall needed work」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The city needed housing」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「the system could not read their faces correctly or their documents needed checking」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
